thread:
mai: Quick profiling update — noticed p95 jump on high-decode-rate cohort after the kernel-selection tweak.
oliver: which cohort exactly? decode-rate >80 t/s or short prompts?
mai: both. short prompts (<=64 tokens) + decode_rate >80 -> p95 +40ms, tokens/sec down ~8%.
rachael: any KV eviction spikes? that usually amplifies latency.
mai: added eviction counters — eviction spikes line up with the p95 regressions.
sam: could be kernel fallback path touching KV more frequently.
mai: deployed a tiny canary of a kernel-selector tweak (score-decay) to 5% — deploy-bot: canary started (id=k-try1) :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary health OK @mai :eyes:
mai: experiment config snippet: 
```
batcher:
  cohort_key: "decode_rate_bucket"
  token_budget_target: 256
  prefer_same_kernel: true
rate_window:
  window_ms: 200
  bins: [0,20,50,100,9999]
```
oliver: token_budget_target=256 might be too low for variable prompt lengths — consider dynamic per-batch budget.
mai: idea: per-batch token_budget = min(512, max(128, avg_prompt_len * 8)) — keeps short prompts small, groups medium ones.
rachael: also bias admission to favor grouping similar decode-rate requests so we avoid kernel flips mid-batch.
mai: bench results so far: baseline p95_high=120ms, canary p95_high=160ms; tokens/sec baseline=420, canary=385.
sam: KV evictions/sec doubled in canary during the window (logs attached).
mai: hypothesis: new kernel path increases KV access frequency on hot decode loops -> cache misses -> latency.
oliver: mitigations: increase kv_cache_size or adjust prefetch stride. downside: higher memory.
rachael: alternative — increase token_budget_target for high-decode bins so we form larger batches and reduce kernel switching.
mai: propose A/B: config A = token_budget 384 + prefer_same_kernel; config B = kv_cache_size +10% (no batching change). add gating and per-bin metrics.
sam: metrics to collect: p95_by_decode_bin, kv_evictions/sec, tokens_per_sec, kernel-switch-count per-second.
mai: schedule: start A/B at tomorrow 10:00 PT, 24h run.
rachael: i'll add dashboards + alerts for p95 delta > 10% and kv evict spike.
mai: ping @oliver to implement sampler change and token_budget calc.
oliver: will open PR today. quick diff: rate_window.window_ms -> 250; add decode_rate_bucket sampler and dynamic_budget calc.
mai: TY — small steps. :thumbsup:
bench-bot: quick benchmark (synthetic high-decode): A(p95_high)=130ms, B(p95_high)=125ms, tokens/sec A=410, B=400 — trending better but noise.
mai: good. iterate on token_budget and kv sizing after the real-world A/B. closing thread for now.
